name: hbm_su_static_kind0_l4_leaf1_1015-r2-COMMIT
purpose: Static SU LIGHT lane (KIND 0) at the accepted LAT4 point (MLAT4/ALAT3/LEAF1, FETCH_EXTRA 2; full512 LAT4 arithmetic join PASS 31 cases, ledger row SU.VOP static F2 spread LAT4): 384 replicas (96 per quarter, 24 per port-group slice of ot_hbm_su_static_top). Seven related 1:1 phase-0 stage roots at the serial 1111 ps clock. First route of this leaf. Outline from the measured LAT4 mapping (7,207 um2 std, lat4_kind0_map) at util 0.5 instead of the 216x216 prototype (util 14%). r2 (H-SU 10-15 23:55): r1 route NEEDS_HUMAN, GRT-0232 twice: initial GRT overflow 0, but post-GRT repair_timing (hold margin 30) pushed the incremental GRT to 3-13 overflows (M5); r1 gate measured 8,909 um2 std in a 14,631 um2 core = util 61 % (spec std_area 7,207 was stale) and 1,649 inputs > 3 logic levels, rst_n 506 async loads. r2 STRUCTURE: owner rule 19:50 pin-registered lane (ot_hbm_su_static_lane_pinreg: every input/output registered at its pin, measured +2 edges requests / +4 writes, absorbed by su_top_compile --pin-reg; whole-SU PIN_REG=1 native proof PASS main 5e84e5bdd) with rst_n registered (PIN_RST=1, b5800d05e); outline re-sized from the measured area at util 0.45 (std ~9,600 um2 incl. ~2,000 pin flops) instead of 0.61. Bench: leaf PASS 3,968 checks first_output 40 (SU_PINREG=1), ADDR/DATA/PHASE mutants FAIL.
